meta.note: Designed for students starting from zero. Every subject covered from scratch. Minimum 6 hrs/day weekdays, 8+ hrs weekends. No prior preparation assumed.

weekday.block: Deep study – new concepts from scratch (lecture + notes)
PYQ practice + DPP on today's topic

weekend.block: Mock test or timed mixed problem set

rules: Start every topic from absolute basics – do not skip fundamentals
No passive lecture watching – pause after every concept and solve problems
PYQs immediately after each topic, not at the end of the week
Error log: write every wrong answer with mistake type and correct concept
Sunday evening: plan the full coming week day by day
Mock tests every Sunday from Week 10 onwards
General Aptitude: 30 min every Saturday throughout the plan

phases.title: Linear Algebra + Probability & Statistics
phases.note: These two are the highest weightage math subjects in GATE DA. Start here. Build from zero.

daily_targets.Mon: Vectors, vector spaces, subspaces – lecture from scratch + 10 PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Linear independence, basis, dimension – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Rank, nullity, rank-nullity theorem – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: System of linear equations (Ax=b): consistency, infinite solutions – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Sat: Diagonalization, symmetric matrices, PSD – lecture + PYQs + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: LA week 1 full revision + all week PYQs re-attempt + next week planning

daily_targets.Mon: Matrix norms, trace, determinant properties – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Full LA PYQ set (GATE DA 2024 + 2025, all LA questions, timed) – review errors
daily_targets.Fri: Probability: sample space, events, axioms – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Conditional probability, Bayes theorem, total probability – lecture + PYQs + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: LA complete revision + Bayes problems + next week planning

daily_targets.Mon: Discrete RVs: PMF, CDF, expected value – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Binomial, Poisson, Geometric distributions – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Continuous RVs: PDF, CDF – Uniform, Exponential distributions – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Normal distribution (standard normal, Z-scores) – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Expectation, variance, standard deviation, moments – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: MGF, moment-generating functions – lecture + PYQs + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Distributions full revision + GATE DA PYQ blitz (all distribution questions) + planning

weekly_plan.subject: Probability & Statistics – Joint Distributions + Inference
topics: Central Limit Theorem, Law of Large Numbers

daily_targets.Mon: Joint distributions: joint PMF/PDF, marginal, conditional – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Covariance, correlation, independence of RVs – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: CLT, LLN, sampling distributions (t, chi-square, F) – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Point estimation: MLE, MAP – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Hypothesis testing (null/alternate, Type I/II errors, p-value) + confidence intervals – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Full P&S PYQ set (GATE DA 2024 + 2025, all P&S questions, timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 1: Linear Algebra + Probability & Statistics (full, 90 min) + analysis

phases.phase_end_milestone: 100% LA + P&S PYQs (GATE DA 2024 + 2025) attempted. Mock 1 score > 60%.

phases.title: Calculus + Optimization + Machine Learning + AI

weekly_plan.subject: Calculus + Optimization
topics: Partial derivatives, chain rule, total derivative

daily_targets.Mon: Limits, continuity, partial derivatives – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Chain rule, total derivative, gradient, directional derivative – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Hessian matrix, critical points, maxima/minima (multivariable) – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Taylor series + convexity (definition, properties, examples) – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Gradient descent, SGD, learning rate, convergence – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions + full Calculus+Optimization PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Calculus + Optimization full revision + mock mini-test + planning

daily_targets.Mon: Linear regression: closed form solution, gradient descent derivation – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Logistic regression: sigmoid, cross-entropy loss – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Regularization (L1/L2), bias-variance tradeoff, overfitting/underfitting – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: SVM: hard margin, soft margin, kernel trick – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Decision trees: entropy, information gain, Gini, ID3 algorithm – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Cross-validation, evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC) – lecture + PYQs + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Supervised ML full revision + GATE DA PYQ blitz + planning

weekly_plan.subject: Machine Learning – Unsupervised + Ensemble + Neural Nets

daily_targets.Mon: k-means clustering: algorithm, convergence, limitations – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: PCA: derivation using eigenvalues, variance explained – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: GMM, EM algorithm: expectation and maximization steps – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Ensemble: Bagging, Boosting, Random Forest, AdaBoost – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Neural networks: perceptron, feedforward, backpropagation, activation functions – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: k-NN + full ML PYQ set (GATE DA 2024 + 2025, all ML questions, timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 2: LA + P&S + Calculus + ML (90 min) + analysis

daily_targets.Mon: Uninformed search: BFS, DFS, UCS – time/space complexity – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Informed search: A* (admissible heuristic), greedy best-first – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Minimax algorithm, alpha-beta pruning – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: CSP: backtracking, constraint propagation, arc consistency – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Propositional logic: connectives, truth tables, resolution – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: FOL: quantifiers, predicates + full AI PYQ set (GATE DA 2024 + 2025) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: AI full revision + mock mini-test: AI only + planning

daily_targets.Mon: ER model: entities, attributes, relationships, ER-to-relational mapping – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Relational algebra: select, project, join, division – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: SQL: joins (inner/outer/cross), subqueries, aggregation, GROUP BY – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Normalization: functional dependencies, 1NF to BCNF, lossy/lossless decomposition – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Transactions: ACID, serializability, conflict serializability, 2PL – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Indexing (B-tree, B+-tree) + full DBMS PYQ set (GATE DA 2024 + 2025, timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 3: LA + P&S + Calculus + ML + AI + DBMS (full 3-hr mock) + analysis

phases.phase_end_milestone: Calculus + ML + AI + DBMS PYQs done. Mock 3 score > 55% (fresh start benchmark).

phases.title: DSA + Python + General Aptitude + Full Revision + Mocks

weekly_plan.subject: DSA + Python Programming
topics: Graphs: BFS, DFS, shortest path, MST

daily_targets.Mon: Arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists + sorting (merge, quick, heap) + complexity – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: BST, AVL trees (rotations), heaps, priority queues – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Graphs: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, MST (Prim, Kruskal) – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Hashing + DP (LCS, knapsack, LIS, edit distance) – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Python: lists, dicts, sets, tuples, comprehensions, OOP, lambda, map/filter – PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: NumPy (arrays, broadcasting, indexing) + Pandas (Series, DataFrame, groupby) – PYQs + Full DSA + Python PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 4: FULL SYLLABUS (3 hr, timed, all subjects) + analysis

weekly_plan.subject: General Aptitude Sprint + Revision Round 1
topics: Verbal ability: reading comprehension, grammar, vocabulary
Numerical ability: percentages, ratio, time-work, time-speed
Analytical reasoning: series, puzzles, data interpretation
Full syllabus rapid revision (1 subject per day)

daily_targets.Mon: Aptitude: verbal ability (RC passages, grammar, fill-in-the-blanks) – PYQ blitz (last 5 years)
daily_targets.Tue: Aptitude: numerical ability (percentages, profit-loss, ratio, time-work) – PYQ blitz
daily_targets.Wed: Aptitude: analytical reasoning (series, analogies, puzzles, DI) – PYQ blitz
daily_targets.Thu: LA + P&S rapid revision – formula sheet + GateOverflow problem set (40 questions, 60 min)
daily_targets.Fri: Calculus + Optimization + ML – formula sheet + GateOverflow problem set (40 questions)
daily_targets.Sat: AI + DBMS + DSA + Python – formula sheet + GateOverflow problem set + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 5: FULL SYLLABUS including Aptitude (3 hr) + analysis

weekly_plan.subject: Targeted Weak Area Revision + Intensive Mocks
topics: Based on mock 5 analysis – drill weakest subjects

daily_targets.Mon: Weakest subject from mock 5 – deep drill (3 hrs: re-study from basics + PYQs)
daily_targets.Wed: 3rd weakest subject + all previous wrong answers re-attempt
daily_targets.Thu: Mock test 6 (full syllabus + Aptitude, 3 hr, timed)
daily_targets.Fri: Mock 6 analysis + error log + formula sheet update
daily_targets.Sat: Mock test 7 (full syllabus + Aptitude, 3 hr) – exam conditions (morning slot) + 30 min Aptitude

weekly_plan.subject: Final Revision + Exam Week
topics: Formula sheets only, no new problems, confidence mocks, exam

daily_targets.Mon: Mock test 8 – exact exam conditions (3 hr, morning, full syllabus)
daily_targets.Tue: Mock 8 analysis + re-attempt all wrong answers
daily_targets.Wed: Formula sheet revision: LA + P&S + Calculus + Optimization
daily_targets.Thu: Formula sheet revision: ML + AI + DBMS + DSA + Python + Aptitude
daily_targets.Fri: Zero new problems. Light read of formula sheets only. Sleep 10 PM.
daily_targets.Sat: Rest. Exam logistics prep. Sleep by 9 PM.

phases.phase_end_milestone: 8+ full mocks done. All subjects covered from scratch. Formula sheets ready. Average mock score 60+.

mock_schedule.scope: Full syllabus except DSA + Python + Aptitude

weekly_targets_summary.focus: Joint distributions, CLT, MLE, hypothesis testing
